text:
Maya Rivera: Drafted a short go-live playbook for customer ramp that focuses on preflight probes, cache seeding, batching presets, streaming preference, and a two-step shadow handoff. Posting for quick edits before we add to the enablement kit.
Santiago Lopez: Love this. Suggest explicit seed TTLs to avoid repeat cold starts. We had one tenant where seeds expired after 2m and performance dropped.
Priya Patel: Recommended TTLs: 10m for heavy generation workloads, 45s for conversational turn caches. Eviction: LRU, max_entries: 10k per-tenant. Add note: shorter TTL reduces memory but ups reseed frequency.
Noah Kim: Telemetry to require: bootstrap.started, seed.attempt, seed.success, seed.failure, bootstrap.finished, bootstrap.p95_ms. Use these to surface renewal risk if bootstrap.duration > 10m or seed_failure_rate > 0.2.
Jen O'Neil: For customer-facing wording, avoid technical terms like "cache miss." Use "initial warmup" or "initial response delay." Include a one-line apology + action to reassure customers if warmup is happening.
Lena V.: Ops run plan: 25m walkthrough with CS + 30m shadow of first 500 requests. Engineering buddy: @Santiago for first slot. Also include a tiny probe set (12 prompts) the CS team can trigger to exercise KV, batching, and streaming.
Maya Rivera: I'll publish probe_set_v1 and add a curl snippet for customers to self-run. Example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/bootstrap -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"acme","probe":"probe_set_v1"}'
Santiago Lopez: Batching defaults to include: chat -> batch_window_ms=20, max_batch_size=48; high-throughput -> batch_window_ms=50, max_batch_size=128. Note tradeoffs: bigger batches reduce cost but increase p50.
Noah Kim: Streaming fallback: prefer streaming=true for UX. If runtime falls back, configure fallback_model and emit stream.fallback.count. Also add a `warning.fallback` event so CS can notify customers gracefully.
Maya Rivera: Escalation triggers to put in playbook: bootstrap > 15m, seed_failure_rate > 20%, p95 latency > 2x baseline, or missing telemetry > 60s. CS should open a ticket, attach the bootstrap_id and trace, and tag SE + oncall.
Jen O'Neil: Add renewal/adoption signal: if bootstrap OK but 7-day active rate < 40%, flag for adoption outreach and schedule a 1:1 enablement session.
Maya Rivera: I'll fold in TTLs, probe set, telemetry names, batching presets, streaming fallback text, and customer-friendly failure language. Will update the draft and ping for final review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
